QuestInfo.name: President Present
QuestInfo.0: #bGrendel the Really Old#k is here! He can fill you in on the story. Hopefully he can get you back to your own world, too.
QuestInfo.2: #bGrendel the Really Old#k wants you to learn to control your powers completely. If you return to your world without that control, the #bsinkhole#k might grow bigger. Master your abilities before you return to Earth.
